children: Navan, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $232.79M, up 35.4% from $171.95M a year earlier, while net loss narrowed to ($29.12M) and diluted loss per share improved to ($0.11).
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by higher gross booking value (GBV) and payment volume as Navan expanded its customer base.
Continued investments in sales-led growth (SLG) and product-led growth (PLG) included increased sales and marketing headcount to accelerate customer acquisition.
Brand and product momentum: the company unified R&M under the Navan brand and highlighted Navan Cognition AI and the Navan Edge mobile experience.
Operational scaling efforts, including AI-powered support, improved gross margin and support investments in Navan Cloud, Navan Connect, and AI virtual agents to boost scalability.
Customer expansion and upsell activity increased, with growth in Expense Management subscriptions and cross-sell of Corporate Payments, Meetings and VIP offerings.
